### Setting up picks up where you left off
Closing Kahf Guard part-way through setup no longer starts you over. Reopen it and you are back on the step you were on, with the answers you already gave.
### A Mac that has already joined is not asked to join again
If this Mac is set up for a child or looked after by an organisation, setting up no longer asks who the Mac is for a second time, and no longer asks for a join code. That code is issued by whoever manages the Mac and works only once — so being asked for another one, on a device that had already joined, left nowhere to go.
Safe Internet is the last step for those Macs, and finishing it is all that is left: no sign-in, because the Mac signed in when it joined.
